Epic: bd-01M1Z987V50254M59P9MNGP9FH
Delivery phase: 5 of 6; child 10 of 12.
Design: docs/design/interaction.md; full snapshot retained in the epic note.
Status: planned work; no implementation or passing evidence is asserted.

Scope
Implement named selections with union/intersection/difference, linked inspectors, explicit filter/recompute commands, undo/redo, and versioned serialization/replay of selection and viewport state. Preserve key-space and source-revision meaning.

Acceptance criteria
1. Selection algebra obeys set laws within compatible key spaces and rejects incompatible operands.
2. Inspectors distinguish visual targets, groups, and exact members; explicit filters report changed input/statistical results separately from visual emphasis.
3. Saved traces restore expected keys and viewport and reject incompatible schema/key codecs or data revisions with typed errors.
4. Undo/redo and external state updates have documented history boundaries and do not replay host effects such as opening URLs or fetching data implicitly.
5. Example workflows run consistently on SVG and Canvas, including partial aggregate selection and data updates.

Exclusions
Persisting arbitrary callbacks, unversioned positional IDs, or silently replaying external side effects.

Required evidence
Algebra laws, independently specified replay fixtures, schema/revision incompatibility probes, and real-browser analytical workflows.
Retain tested source SHA, fixture inputs, expected outputs, and actual gate results. Pending or unavailable checks remain explicitly pending.

Prerequisites
bd-01M1Z9B3YV0BAR2R6KJF1TWE13

Coordination
Reserve only actual files when implementation starts. Parent containment is not a prerequisite on the epic; do not create a child-to-epic dependency cycle.
set.title: [Intaglio][Interaction 10] Add selection algebra, inspectors, coordinated filters, and replayable history
